relations.text: 旧親会社。2016年に分離契約を結んでValvolineを分離
relations.text_en: Former parent; separated Valvoline under a 2016 separation agreement

source.label: Ashland 10-K(2024年提出)
source.quote: Separation Agreement dated as of September 22, 2016, between and among Ashland Global Holdings Inc. and Valvoline Inc.

relations.text: 2023年3月、潤滑油の製品事業(Global Products)をAramcoに売却し、供給契約を結ぶ
relations.text_en: Bought Valvoline's Global Products lubricants business in March 2023, with a supply agreement

source.label: Valvoline 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: On March 1, 2023, Valvoline completed the sale of its former Global Products reportable segment ("Global Products") , now doing business as Valvoline Global Operations ("VGO") to Aramco Overseas Company B.V.

source.label: Valvoline 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: On December 1, 2025, the Company acquired 100 % of the equity interests in Breeze Autocare ("Breeze") for total cash consideration of $ 637.4 million .
